propositions: Cold cache causes the first ~6 concurrent Pass-1 calls to each independently write the byte-identical system prefix, resulting in ~3.7x token overhead versus an ideal single write

Warm-then-fan-out pattern from container bins can be ported to the main pool: run the first chunk serially to write the cache prefix when shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and >= 2 calls exist, then fan out the remainder to the 6-wide pool
A non-systemic failure during the warm call should degrade gracefully to direct fan-out of remaining calls without aborting the review
A systemic LLMUnavailableError during the warm call should abort the entire review
With the warm gate met, exactly one cache write should occur for the shared prefix and N-1 calls should perform cache reads
